extracted.intended_audience: creative marketing and communications professionals (creatives, agency leaders, brands, marketers, creators)
extracted.subtask_description: A promotional/overview page for the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity describing the Festival, Awards, programmes, and what the Awards recognise in creative marketing and advertising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creativity / Creative excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: The Awards are where the new benchmark for global creative excellence is set each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cannes Lions celebrates creativity across advertising, marketing and communications; entrants and winners are presented as examples of benchmark-setting creative work ("watch the work awarded on stage, or make history yourself").

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating creativity, effectiveness and innovation in the global advertising, marketing and communication industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work is valued not only for creative merit but for how effectively it achieves business/communication objectives—implying evaluation of outcomes and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating creativity, effectiveness and innovation in the global advertising, marketing and communication industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innovation is highlighted as a core dimension of judged work—novel approaches, new concepts or uses of technology (e.g., programmes exploring AI's impact) are of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business impact / growth
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore how global brands like Google, Patagonia and P&G are using creativity to grow their business and connect with customers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows an evaluative emphasis on work that demonstrably grows business or strengthens customer connection; effectiveness and commercial outcomes are part of the Festival's focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organisational systems, cultures and capabilities (Creative Brand Lion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The new Creative Brand Lion recognises the systems, cultures and capabilities that make world-class creative inevitable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award dimension evaluates not just individual pieces of work but the internal organisational enablers (processes, culture, capabilities) that produce consistent, high-quality creative output.
